heroHeadline: UK Sanctions Target Putin's War Chest, Propagandists and Military Torturers Amid Ongoing Ukraine Conflict
heroSubtitle: Russia launched a nationwide barrage of over 170 drones, glide bombs and missiles into September 27, killing 14 and injuring 57 across Ukraine in 24 hours. A mass strike on Odesa Oblast killed 1 and damaged a hotel, medical facility and grain storage; Russian shelling and an FPV drone strike killed 3 across the Zaporizhzhia villages of Komyshuvakha and Novotavriiske; and drones struck a Kyiv data centre twice, injuring 3 including 2 children. The toll from the September 26 glide-bomb strike on a Sumy family support centre rose to 3 killed and 28 injured. Separately, Bloomberg reported that President Trump again pressed Zelensky to travel to Moscow for talks with Putin during their September 22 UN meeting; Zelensky declined, quipping he would visit 'on a missile,' while his office denied the account.
footerNote: Data sourced from official government reports, UN monitoring missions, major international outlets, and institutional analyses. Historical data draws on peer-reviewed scholarship. Casualty figures are contested; ranges reflect scholarly and official estimates.
